jumpstart_matches.description: Jump-start a new or existing product with open source. Read project context, discover and vet repositories, propose a CTO-style menu of components and combinations, then selectively simplify, integrate, test, and credit the chosen pieces. Use when the user wants open-source foundations, reusable implementations, or alternatives to building a substantial feature from scratch. (user)
